item.text: I’ll build the base plate and curved round post, then compare all four views to refine the proportions and orientation.

arguments.code:
import math
r=5
R=27
H=62
base=cq.Workplane('XY').box(40,40,3,centered=(True,True,False))
post=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=3).circle(r).extrude(H)
path=cq.Workplane('XZ').moveTo(0,65).threePointArc((27,92),(54,65)).wire()
arc=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=65).circle(r).sweep(path)
result=base.union(post).union(arc)
arguments.label: Base plate and curved post
